correctness.rationale: Checked incidence normalization BB^T=nI-J, Π=I-(1/n)B^TB, projected edge squared norms (n-2)/n, intrinsic dimension d=(n-1)(n-2)/2. Polar Q=circulations in [-1,1]^E; a point is a polar vertex iff unsaturated edge graph is a forest, since cycle perturbations exclude nonvertices and forest carries no nonzero circulation. Cut conservation forces unsaturated integral entries, hence zeros; even-degree supported trinary flows yield zero forest parity deg_F(v)=n-1 mod 2. For odd n finite forest of even degrees must be empty; for even n forest has at least n/2 edges, equality precisely a perfect matching, attainable by Eulerian orientation of its complement. Uniqueness and S_n orthogonal irreducibility on the triangle-generated cycle space imply both extremal ellipsoids are balls. Independently exhausted all {-1,0,1} balanced forest-support flows n=4,5, reproducing norms multiplicities (8,6) and (24); original checked n=6 as well. Finite checks are not a full all-n proof.
residual_risks: Finite forest-flow counts for small n are corroboration only; S_n irreducibility and all-n parity forest proof supply necessity
